title: Jesse Minter: There was discussion about Lamar Jackson returning, hopefully he's in a good spot

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jesse Minter: There was discussion about Lamar Jackson returning, hopefully he's in a good spot
sources.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson did not play in the second half of Sunday's win over the Titans because of an ankle injury, but head coach Jesse Minter did not make it sound like there's much fear of a long-term injury after the game.
